name: Paarthurnax
isnote: The naming paper calls it a neosuchian crocodyliform; English Wikipedia places it in Goniopholididae.
sum: Paarthurnax is a neosuchian crocodyliform from the Aptian-Albian Holly Creek Formation of Arkansas, about 4 m long.
wsnote: Total length about 3.975 m, estimated by the authors (English Wikipedia); skull about 530 mm.
holotype: TxVP 41881-1, a nearly complete skull with a single partial paravertebral osteoderm.
biology: The sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Platt et al. 2025

sources.text: Platt, N. C., Adams, T. L. and Brochu, C. A. 2025. A new neosuchian crocodyliform from the Lower Cretaceous (Aptian-Albian) Holly Creek Formation. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology e2536843.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Aptian to Albian per English Wikipedia.
